description: This file defines the WeightClass model class for the OpenCart admin localisation module. It contains methods to add, edit, delete, and retrieve weight class data and descriptions from the database.

classes.name: WeightClass
classes.description: Class for managing weight class data, including CRUD operations and retrieving descriptions and totals.

methods.name: addWeightClass
methods.description: Adds a new weight class to the database, including descriptions in multiple languages.

methods.name: editWeightClass
methods.description: Modifies an existing weight class record and its descriptions.

methods.name: deleteWeightClass
methods.description: Deletes a weight class and all its descriptions from the database.

methods.name: getWeightClasses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of weight classes with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getWeightClass
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific weight class by ID.

methods.name: getTotalWeightClasses
methods.description: Returns the total number of weight classes in the database.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a weight class in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Removes all descriptions associated with a specific weight class ID.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Removes all descriptions for a specific language across all weight classes.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific weight class.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all weight class descriptions for a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByUnit
methods.description: Retrieves description data for a specific weight unit.
